claims.text: Baseline methods include NaiveNN, FANN, and a non-domain-adaptive baseline with bag-of-words representations and SVM classifier.
NaiveNN is a non-domain-adaptive CNN trained solely on the source domain, which limits its effectiveness on the target domain.
FANN is another baseline method that suffers from similar limitations as NaiveNN in cross-domain sentiment classification.
